## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it resolves or addresses.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Performance improvement

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Rust unit and integration tests pass (`cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`)
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly with no TypeScript errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Verified on Windows, Linux, or macOS
- [ ] DevIgnite Doctor diagnostics pass cleanly
